column2: The five elite lines carried into the comparison. First chosen 2026-09-10;
two lines replaced 2026-09-14 after the call-rate screen. Rows are in order of
release year, which is also the order of the elite rows in the figures.
SELECTION RULE, stated so it can be audited:
1. All five come from the DivBrowse panel's `accession type = elite lines`
subset (315 of 1315), the only subset where cultivar name, breeder and
year of release are all present in the EBI BioSamples record. Every label
in the figures is therefore machine-verifiable, not a manual lookup.
2. All five are SPRING MALTING types, deliberately. Winter and spring barley
are strongly genetically differentiated; a mixed set would put a
population-structure axis into the elite block, so a barcode difference
could reflect winter-vs-spring rather than anything about the gene.
3. Every line is called at >= 85% of the shared sites, pooled over the three
genes (results/tables/Table_elite_line_screen.tsv, all 136 spring elite
lines scored; asserted by 02_screen_elite_lines.R). The panel is unimputed
low-coverage sequencing, so no-calls are a per-line property. This is a
genotype-QUALITY criterion only -- it never looks at which haplotype a line
carries, so it cannot steer the comparison. 91 of 136 lines pass.
4. Among passing lines: widely grown, well-known malting cultivars. The two
replacements were additionally required to reach >= 80% at EVERY gene, so
no gene is drawn with many grey tiles.
HISTORY
2026-09-10  RGT Planet, Laureate, LG Diablo, KWS Irina, Propino (chosen on fame)
2026-09-14  RGT Planet (53.4% called; 41.7% at PHT4;3) and Propino (62.5%;
25.0% at PHT4;3) failed the screen and were replaced by Avalon
(96.6%) and Odyssey (94.3%). Explorer, arguably as well known,
passes overall (88.6%) but is called at only 66.7% of PHT4;3
sites, so it was not taken.
NOT used: the six lines of the earlier (pre-publication) analysis in
USED_Haplotype_Analysis/Wild_And_Elite. Four of those six (Corvette, Triumph,
Iris, Gunnar) are samples that carry ONLY an IPK genebank number (HOR 11013,
HOR 2970, HOR 12070, HOR 10702) and no cultivar name in any public record, so
their names could not be verified; "Triumph" additionally collides with a
differently-named sample in the same panel (SAMEA110189957 = "LG Triumph").
The other two (Manchuria HOR 10695, Rapid HOR 8662) are correctly named but
belong to the `precision collection` (genebank landraces), not to elite
breeding material.
